responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduling model for the SiFive P400 microarchitecture. It describes the core’s issue pipelines, execution units, latencies, instruction reservations, and bypass paths for integer, branch, load/store, atomic, multiply/divide, and floating-point operations under `-mtune=sifive_p400`, giving the scheduler a P400-specific throughput and hazard model distinct from other SiFive and generic cores.
